newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGB futures end higher amid caution ahead of G7.
newsitem.headline: JGB futures end higher amid caution ahead of G7.

text.p: Key March Japanese government bond (JGB) futures ended Friday's Tokyo session higher following a fall in Tokyo stocks.
The March closed up 0.28 at 126.56. Turnover was 45,224 contracts.

The benchmark contract hit an intraday high of 126.59 in the early afternoon as the Nikkei dipped below 18,000, traders said. The Nikkei average of 225 leading shares closed down 171.39 points, or 0.95 percent, at 17,867.04.
"JGB futures extended gains in the afternoon on the Nikkei's fall," said a brokerage house trader.
